thread.title: UPDATE: Apple officially becomes first U.S. company with $1 trillion market cap

author: morningstar.com
title: UPDATE: Apple officially becomes first U.S. company with $1 trillion market cap
text:
By Emily Bary
Apple shares closed at $207.39, up 2.9%
Apple Inc. became the first U.S. listed company to reach a $1 trillion market capitalization on Thursday.
Apple shares(AAPL)closed at $207.39, above the $207.04 threshold needed for Apple to officially hit the trillion-dollar mark. That's based on its most up-to-date share count (http://www.marketwatch.com/story/apple-updates-share-count-as-it-closes-is-on-1-trillion-market-cap-2018-08-01) of 4.83 billion as of July 20. The current market-cap calculations assume that Apple's share count hasn't budged since that date, though that's unlikely given the company's rapid pace of share buybacks (http://www.marketwatch.com/story/apple-stock-buybacks-spiked-to-a-new-high-as-shares-suffered-a-correction-2018-05-01).
The stock's strong performance this week comes after Apple reported better-than-expected results (http://www.marketwatch.com/story/apple-path-to-1-trillion-accelerates-as-consumers-flock-to-pricey-iphones-2018-08-01) for its fiscal third quarter on Tuesday. The company also delivered an upbeat forecast for its September quarter, when it typically releases new iPhones.
In its two-day push to get to $1 trillion, Apple added $82 billion in market capitalization.
Opinion: Why a trillion-dollar Apple market cap is nothing to celebrate (http://www.marketwatch.com/story/why-a-trillion-dollar-apple-is-nothing-to-celebrate-2018-08-02)
After Amazon.com Inc.(AMZN)reported earnings last week and saw its stock jump, some -- including a majority of MarketWatch readers participating in an informal poll (http://www.marketwatch.com/story/first-to-1-trillion-amazon-or-apple-no-brainer-the-people-have-spoken-2018-07-19) -- thought the company would beat Apple to the trillion-dollar punch. Amazon's market capitalization sat at roughly $873 billion Thursday, ahead of Alphabet Inc.(GOOGL) (GOOGL), with its $849 million market cap, and Microsoft Corp.(MSFT)at $818 billion.
Apple won't technically be the first publicly traded company to reach $1 trillion in market capitalization, as PetroChina earned that honor on the Chinese market more than a decade ago (http://www.marketwatch.com/story/petrochina-soars-to-1-trillion-market-cap-in-debut). The company's valuation has come down sharply in the years since (http://www.marketwatch.com/story/apple-1-trillion-heres-the-meltdown-that-followed-the-first-company-to-get-there-2018-08-01).
And Saudi Aramco, the Saudi Arabian state-owned oil giant, which reportedly intends to go public in 2019, was recently estimated to possess a valuation of about $2 trillion (http://www.marketwatch.com/story/massive-saudi-aramco-ipo-likely-to-be-delayed-until-2019-report-2018-03-11), according to the Financial Times.
Shares of Apple are up 32% over the past 12 months. The Dow Jones Industrial Average , of which Apple is a component, has gained 15% in that span.
-Emily Bary; 1627ET
